rows.70:0d00:
"All right!
All right already, don't crowd me like that."
Maybe my intensity overwhelmed him, because Hino's eyes went wide as he nodded over and over.
Then he hurriedly picked up my manuscript.
"If you're pushing this hard, you must be pretty confident in what you wrote."
"Of course I am."
I answered, full of confidence.
"I see..."
With just that, Hino quietly began to read the manuscript.
At first it seemed like he was just glancing over it, but gradually his expression grew serious...
He finished reading it in no time.{p}
rows.70:0fd4:
"{a}..."
Tapping the pages of the manuscript into a neat stack, Hino slowly began to speak.
"Yes!"
Full of hope, I waited for his next words...
...And?{p}
rows.70:14a0: Hino wouldn't hear a word of it and all but chased me out of the club room.{p}
rows.70:18a8:
The boy...
The newspaper club room grew farther and farther behind me.
"Hey, Sakagami.
There's something I wanted to ask you.
Come on, get in here..."
Far behind me, I heard Hino's delighted voice.
...Sakagami?
Is that the boy's name...?{p}
rows.70:1b80: She'd be upset if I told her the article got scrapped, wouldn't she?{p}Hmm, but then again, it'd be wrong to get her hopes up for nothing...
rows.70:1cd4:
"Hmm, is that so?"
"Yeah, that's how it is.
Ahaha...
W-well, I'm in a hurry, so I'll go on ahead.
...Bye!"{p}
rows.70:231c: As I stopped to catch my breath, thinking that, the stall door right in front of me suddenly opened......{p}
rows.70:2724:
"I'm thinking of getting them to invite me to that meeting again.
Just like I got to be friends with you, {a}, I want to be friends with this Sakagami too.
I want lots of friends, after all.
Hey, {a}.
Could you put in a word with Sakagami for me too, so he'll invite me to the seven wonders?
I'll have a really special story ready..."{p}
rows.70:2a64:
But I don't know anyone like that!
All sorts of thoughts were swirling round and round in my head.
It felt like if I let them be, I'd be swallowed up in the swirl myself, and my vision swam.
Who on earth is this Sakagami★
...Just then, someone tapped me on the shoulder.{p}
rows.70:2be0:
"Yo.
So you're in 1-E too, {a}.
Well, I hardly ever come to the first-year classrooms.
Today I've got some business with Sakagami...{p}You know where he is?"
rows.70:38ec:
"I heard about you too.
Let me see... Your name is Sakagami, isn't it?"
...What★
W-wait a minute!
"Hee hee hee hee...
I'm so pleased.
To think the one who came to interview us would be such a lovely boy."{p}
rows.70:39c0:
Me, Sakagami...?
A lovely boy...?
What is everyone talking about★
Just then...
...What★
I was stunned when I saw my reflection in the window glass.
Reflected there was a boy in a white dress shirt.
I looked away in a panic, so I didn't get a good look at the face...
But that was definitely me.
What on earth has happened to me...?{p}
rows.70:4cd4:
"What, you haven't heard yet?
You're as out of the loop as ever.
That's why the article you worked so hard to research got scrapped."
..........Gulp!
He already knows.{p}
rows.70:580c:
"Ahaha...
Shy as ever, aren't you?"
Talking to this guy just wears me out.
"{b}...
Do you know what this spot is called?
It's called an 'odoriba,' a landing.
In other words, a place for 'odori'... for dancing.
Come on, you've gotta dance, baby."
"Wh-what?"
Why does this guy always march to the beat of his own drum?{p}
